_comment: List of companies to track. 'overrides' lets you pin a company to a known ATS + identifier once you find it (see README 'Adding companies manually'). Leave overrides empty and the discovery engine will try to auto-detect Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters slugs from the name.
companies: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

overrides._comment: Example format once you've identified a company's ATS by hand: "Anthropic": {"ats": "greenhouse", "id": "anthropic"}. See README for how to find these values for Workday/Rippling/custom sites.

Base-2 Solutions._note: Actual ATS is Oracle Taleo (phh.tbe.taleo.net, org=BASESOLU), which this app doesn't support. Pinned to null so auto-discovery stops matching an unrelated company's Ashby board (slug 'base') that has no organizationName field to catch the collision.

Applied Research Associates._note: Auto-discovery matched Applied Intuition's Ashby board (slug 'applied') and imported 260 of their jobs under this name. Ashby's response for that board has no organizationName field, so the probe's identity check was skipped entirely. Pinned to null until someone finds ARA's real board (ara.com/careers).

Agile Mission Integration._note: Auto-discovery matched an unrelated company's Greenhouse board (slug 'agile') -- the imported jobs were 'Forklift Driver' and 'Bilingual HR Business Partner'. Pinned to null; find the real board before re-enabling.

Trase Systems._note: Auto-discovery matched an unrelated 'trase' Greenhouse board (healthcare sales roles). Pinned to null; find the real board before re-enabling.

Legion Intelligence._note: Auto-discovery matched greenhouse 'legion' -- but that board is Legion Technologies (workforce-mgmt software, jobs in Bucharest/Bangalore, 'General Counsel'/'Consultant'), NOT this defense-AI company. 16 wrong jobs were imported. Pinned to null; find the real board before re-enabling.

SAIC._note: Pinned to the verified workable board (reports name 'SAIC') so it doesn't depend on auto-discovery, which can fall through to a generic weak-slug board when workable rate-limits.

General Dynamics Information Technology._note: Full-name workable board (reports 'General Dynamics Information Technology'). Pinned so it can't fall through to the junk 'general' Rippling board on a transient failure.

Analytica._note: JazzHR-hosted (applytojob.com) but server-rendered with real per-job <a href> links, so the generic scraper works fine -- no dedicated JazzHR scraper needed.

AutoRabit._note: JazzHR-hosted (applytojob.com), works via the generic scraper -- see Analytica.

EY._note: SuccessFactors ATS with public careers portal at careers.ey.com/search/ -- scraper fetches US jobs with pagination.

Elder Research._note: ClearCompany/HRMDirect ATS with public job board at elderresearch.hrmdirect.com/employment/ -- has Defense & Intelligence roles with clearance eligibility requirements.

Evans & Chambers._note: ApplicantStack ATS with public job board at evanschambers.applicantstack.com -- multiple TS/SCI + Polygraph required roles, heavy Defense & Intelligence focus.

Niantic Spatial._note: Ashby job board at jobs.ashbyhq.com/niantic (0 postings as of last check)

iMetalX._note: Workable account confirmed valid but 0 open postings as of the last check -- will pick up automatically once they post something.

RedArch Solutions._note: JazzHR-hosted (applytojob.com), works via the generic scraper -- see Analytica.

Xenith Solutions._note: JazzHR-hosted (applytojob.com), works via the generic scraper -- see Analytica.

Epsilon Systems._note: Custom one-off scraper (src/scrapers/epsilon_systems.py) for their Angular app's API at workforce.epsilonsystems.com/api/jobpostings. The identifier is unused (the URL is hardcoded, not a multi-tenant platform) -- kept non-null for clarity.

Goliath Partners._note: Custom OctoberCMS job board (goliathpartners.com/jobs) -- fintech/trading recruiting platform with salary data.

Google._note: Fully custom in-house careers system (careers.google.com) -- not scrapable with any supported ATS.

Impulse Space._note: Pinpoint ATS (impulsespace.pinpointhq.com) -- new scraper added at src/scrapers/pinpoint.py. Job links have no job/career/position keyword in the URL path so the generic scraper's link-discovery misses them; postings.json feed used instead.

Microsoft._note: Custom Adobe AEM careers site (careers.microsoft.com) -- not scrapable with any supported ATS.

DanSolutions._note: dansolutions.com is a JS-rendered SPA with no supported ATS reference in the raw HTML.

Torchlight.AI._note: torchlight.ai/career is a JS SPA (empty root div, Vite bundle) -- no supported ATS found.

OptiSources._note: optisourcesinc.com has no real careers/job-listing page, only a contact form.

AnomalySix._note: anomalysix.com/careers is a static Squarespace marketing page -- no job listings, iframes, or ATS reference anywhere.

Compass Inc._note: Real company is Compass, Inc. (cmpsinc.com, Winchester VA defense/intel SETA firm -- not the real-estate brand). Careers run through ApplicantStack (compassinc.applicantstack.com) -- unsupported ATS.

Cybastion Technologies._note: Real domain is cybastiontech.com (cybastion.com is an unrelated parked domain). Careers page is static WordPress listing job-description PDFs, apply via mailto: -- no ATS at all.

Kearney._note: Yello/Recsolu (kearney.recsolu.com) -- unsupported ATS; main kearney.com site is also Cloudflare-blocked to non-browser requests.

LitheSpeed._note: lithespeed.com/careers explicitly states "No positions currently open" and has no ATS integration.

Mckinsey and Company._note: Public API at gateway.mckinsey.com/apigw-x0cceuow60/v1/api/jobs/search -- no auth required, returns full JSON job data.

Percipient._note: percipient.ai/careers 404s; the stale jobs.lever.co/percipient link on their homepage returns "Document not found" against the real Lever API -- board is dead, no working replacement found.

Prescient Edge._note: prescientedge.hua.hrsmart.com renders job listings in a JS-driven table with no per-job static href (the only href pattern found is a 'find_similar_jobs' utility link, not a real job-detail page) -- not scrapable by the generic link-following scraper.

Rocket Lab._note: Custom-branded careers page at rocketlabcorp.com/careers wraps a Greenhouse board (job-boards.greenhouse.io/rocketlab); using the Greenhouse API directly instead.

Recro._note: recro.com/careers -> ats.recro.com/jobboard is a fully client-rendered Blazor Server SPA with no job data in raw HTML. (recrocdmo.com, a previously-considered domain, does not resolve.)

Dell._note: Confirmed Workday tenant (dell.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com, site External, via real job URLs) but the /wday/cxs/.../jobs API consistently returns total:0 from curl -- Cloudflare bot-protection appears to soft-block the API for non-browser requests.

Deloitte._note: Avature ATS with public RSS feed at apply.deloitte.com/en_US/careers/SearchJobs/feed/ -- scraper fetches jobs from feed and detail pages for location/description.

Hypergiant._note: hypergiant.com/careers still references Rippling board id 'accelinthypergiant', but https://ats.rippling.com/api/v2/board/accelinthypergiant/jobs returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND -- the board is deprecated/deleted with no working replacement found on the page.

ACS-I._note: Could not confirm which real company this refers to -- candidates checked (ACS Solutions / American CyberSystems, ACS Government Solutions, ACS International) either have no findable careers site or no live postings.

CommonGround Labs._note: No defense/govcon company found under this name -- only unrelated orgs (Common Ground Alliance, Common Ground Research Networks, etc.) turned up.

Data Goliath._note: No defense/intel company found under this name -- only unrelated "Goliath Data" (real estate AI) and Bruce Schneier's book "Data and Goliath" turned up.

Saber Technologies._note: Best-guess identity is Saber Astronautics (saberastro.com, DoD Secret-clearance SDA roles) after ruling out Sabre Systems and Saber Technology Solutions LLC -- but their Gatsby-built careers page is JS-rendered with only one job link present in raw HTML, so it's not a reliable generic-scraper target even with identity confirmed.

Stellarvision Inc.._note: Only match found is a Korean SAR-satellite company (stellarvision.co.kr); stellarvision.com is an unrelated parked domain. No confirmed US entity with clearance-relevant postings.

SKS.ai._note: Real company is Summit Knowledge Solutions (sks.ai/current-openings, SDVOB doing IC ontology/knowledge-graph work) -- no third-party ATS, and both listed roles currently show "No current openings", so there's nothing to scrape right now.

Pinnacle Business._note: No company named exactly "Pinnacle Business" found -- closest candidates (Pinnacle Government Solutions, Pinnacle Government Consulting, Pinnacle Solutions/Akima) are distinct companies, identity unconfirmed.

Domino._note: Real company is Domino Data Lab (domino.ai), not the previously-guessed 'Domino Technologies, Inc.' staffing firm -- has active DoD/public-sector clearance roles.

Lyntris._note: JobBoardHQ platform at lyntris.jobboardhq.com -- defense technology company combining Accelint and Vitesse, requires security clearances for many roles, salary data included.

Matroid._note: Breezy HR (new scraper at src/scrapers/breezy.py). List endpoint at {slug}.breezy.hr/json; description/salary come from a schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD block on each job's detail page.

WBR Ltd._note: Real company is W R Systems, Ltd. (wrsystems.com), not Worldwide Business Research -- SilkRoad ATS isn't directly supported but the listing page has real per-job links.

IDA._note: Institute for Defense Analyses (IDA), a defense-focused FFRDC. New scraper at src/scrapers/taleo.py for Oracle Taleo Business Edition -- session+CSRF-based POST search, detail pages parsed via embedded schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD.

TRM Labs._note: Ashby embed at jobs.ashbyhq.com/trm-labs; the site also references a Greenhouse embed but that script tag is commented out (legacy, no longer live).

Trident Systems._note: ADP WorkforceNow (new scraper at src/scrapers/adp.py). ADP's public API exposes no description text at all, only structured metadata (title/location/salary), so clearance/citizenship/polygraph signals can't be detected for this company -- a platform limitation, not a data quality bug.

Turion Space._note: Framer-built site (turionspace.com/careers) loads jobs via a client-side widget with no ATS marker in raw HTML; found by testing common slug variants directly against Ashby's API.
